about: Official sources the Wajibat generators read. `path` is relative to scripts/wajibat/.cache/ (git-ignored). `sha256` is of that file with CRLF normalised to LF. `fetched` is the date the file was downloaded (file date). Re-create with `python fetch_sources.py`; see README.md.

files.book: رساله نماز و روزه (Persian original of the Rules; used only to decide show/hide, never displayed)
نماز اور روزه کی احکام (official Urdu edition of the Rules on Prayer & Fasting; not yet matched to rulings, P18)
احکام آموزشی (official Urdu translation of Risāla-yi Āmūzishī; source for Khamenei's wuḍūʾ helper, P16, Phase 4b)
